description: Figure 7 is a line chart that illustrates the Micro F1 (%) score of the KnowPrompt model as a function of the number of training samples generated by LLMs. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Samples Generated," is on a linear scale and shows four discrete data points: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis, labeled "Micro F1 (%)", is also linear and ranges from 20 to 50. The chart displays four distinct lines, each representing a different method: TACRED (blue), TACRED-Revisit (orange), Re-TACRED (green), and SemEval (red). All four lines show an increasing trend as the number of generated samples increases. For all methods, the Micro F1 score peaks at K=32 and then slightly decreases at K=64. At K=8, the scores are approximately 23% (TACRED), 24% (TACRED-Revisit), 35% (Re-TACRED), and 42% (SemEval). At K=32, the scores reach their maximum, with Re-TACRED achieving the highest score of approximately 50%, followed by SemEval at about 47%, TACRED-Revisit at 30%, and TACRED at 29%. At K=64, all methods show a decline, with Re-TACRED at about 47%, SemEval at 51%, TACRED-Revisit at 30%, and TACRED at 29%.
